text: This report requests that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 88 Toynbee Trail. The application indicates the reason for removal is due to safety concerns. The subject tree is a Norway spruce (Picea abies), measuring 46 cm in diameter. The Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
City Council on March 9, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 88 Toynbee Trail.
